# Livemint

> > Livemint is India's premier financial news platform providing live market data, stock tracking, commodity prices, and comprehensive business news coverage.

Livemint delivers real-time Indian and global market information including stock indices (Sensex, Nifty), NSE/BSE data, commodity prices, and breaking business news. The platform integrates premium content from Wall Street Journal and The Economist alongside original analysis and price tracking for precious metals, fuels, and cryptocurrencies.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market News
- Live Market Updates
- Sensex & Nifty
- BSE/NSE Trading
- IPO Tracker
- Commodity Prices
- Gold & Silver Prices
- Cryptocurrency
- US Markets
- Breaking News
- Market Analysis
- Precious Metals
- Price Tracking
- Indian Stocks
- Global Markets

## Live Market Data & Indices

- [Livemint Homepage](https://www.livemint.com): Mint homepage with live market data, Sensex, Nifty, and business news.
- [Market Statistics Dashboard](https://www.livemint.com/market/market-stats): Live market statistics dashboard for Indian stocks, NSE/BSE data, and company info.
- [Market News Hub](https://www.livemint.com/market): Market news hub with live Sensex, Nifty, BSE/NSE, and commodity updates.
- [India Indices Today](https://www.livemint.com/market/india-indices): Live Indian stock indices including Nifty 50, BSE Sensex, and market data.

## Stock Market & IPO News

- [Stock Market News](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news): Stock market news and headlines covering Indian and global market updates.
- [IPO Tracker 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo): IPO tracker with live updates on subscriptions, GMP, allotment, and 2026 calendar.
- [Mark to Market Analysis](https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market): Daily expert analysis of India's top companies with valuation and sector insights.

## Global Markets & Bonds

- [US Stock Market Today](https://www.livemint.com/market/us-market): Live US market data for Dow Jones, Nasdaq, S&P 500 with real-time tracking.
- [Bond Market News & Analysis](https://www.livemint.com/market/bonds): Bond market news and analysis covering government, corporate, and treasury bonds.

## Commodities & Precious Metals

- [Commodity Market News](https://www.livemint.com/market/commodities): Commodity market news with live prices for gold, crude oil, and MCX trading.
- [Live Gold Prices](https://www.livemint.com/gold-prices): Live gold prices in India by carat with city-wise rates and historical data.
- [Live Silver Prices](https://www.livemint.com/silver-prices): Live silver prices in India with daily rates and historical tracking by weight.

## Energy Prices & Cryptocurrency

- [Live Petrol Prices](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices-petrol): Live petrol prices in India with state-wise rates and historical data tracking.
- [Live Diesel Prices](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices-diesel): Live diesel prices in India with state-wise rates and crude oil impact analysis.
- [Cryptocurrency News & Prices](https://www.livemint.com/market/cryptocurrency): Cryptocurrency news and price tracking for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple, and digital assets.

## Breaking News & Analysis

- [Live News Updates](https://www.livemint.com/news): Breaking news hub covering India, world, business, politics, and entertainment.
- [India News Today](https://www.livemint.com/news/india): Latest India news covering politics, business, current affairs, and government updates.
- [World News Headlines](https://www.livemint.com/news/world): International news and headlines covering geopolitics, conflicts, and global events.

## Premium Content Partners

- [Wall Street Journal](https://www.livemint.com/wsj): Wall Street Journal content on business, markets, finance, and global strategy.
- [The Economist](https://www.livemint.com/economist): The Economist articles on world news, economics, politics, and business analysis.
